responsibilities: Manage the main engine ticking architecture.
Handle VSync synchronization directly via dart:ui PlatformDispatcher.
Manage delta time (dt) calculation and provide smooth, capped time steps for engine systems to prevent physics explosions on lag spikes.
constraints: Must not use Flutter's Ticker or AnimationController.
Must rely purely on PlatformDispatcher.instance.onBeginFrame / onDrawFrame.
All time state must be held in primitive types (double, int).
